note: Truth per copy, from sources other than the plan check. Source keys: scorer = rm-facts clause_check on the copy (truth-raw/rm-facts-*.json); labeling = repair-labeling --check-only on the copy against the trace bank (copies/**.labeling_check.json; shop has no trace bank, so the freeze gate record FP/gate/shop/<card>.json labeling.ok); ruling = user rulings of 2026-11-22 (M/decisions.md:540-578); trained = FP/results/summary.md judged success (FARM / ARM-FM / no-RM); paper = a C/docs/paper/README.md entry; construction = the mutant's edit (spec.json). Supplementary, outside the packet's list and marked as such: pay-order = check-pay-order with main's code (truth-raw/pay-order-2-*.json); hand-read = my reading of the machine against the card (ARM-FM has no stored clauses, so no scorer). unclear = the sources disagree or do not decide; such copies are left out of the counts.
